body:
Suzanne Flannery, managing director and head of strategic initiatives at Grafine Partners (Photo credit: Grafine Partners)

Grafine Partners named Suzanne Flannery managing director and head of strategic initiatives, a newly created position.

Flannery joins from Neuberger Berman, where she led a global team supporting the firm’s investment offerings as managing director and head of the Product Marketing Platform.

Before joining Neuberger Berman, she spent nine years at Goldman Sachs in senior roles across portfolio management, client solutions and hedge fund investing. Earlier in her career, she worked at J.P. Morgan and Monitor Group.

Flannery now works with Grafine founder Elizabeth Weymouth, who launched the firm in 2019 after serving as a partner at Riverstone Holdings, where she built a business focused on identifying sector-specialist private equity firms and investing alongside them in high-alpha opportunities.

Grafine has grown to approximately $1 billion in assets under management. Flannery’s experience will strengthen Grafine’s ability to scale and boost engagement, according to Weymouth. Flannery will also help further institutionalize the firm’s investment, capital formation and operations functions while increasing its direct investment activity.

The New York-based firm closed its Grafine Capital I fund with $600 million in total capital commitments in 2024, gathering capital from investors such as CAZ Investments, which committed $200 million to the firm in 2023. RedBird Capital was also an early backer.
